notes: the whole of Box 1 is reported under the Emirate of the fixed establishment (none was handed in) — the ledgers carry no Emirate (ER Art. 72(2))
VAT-exclusive, and including zero-rated and exempt purchases (the ledgers hold them under the same accounts); the VAT column is what was posted to Input VAT
